test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63b7c8837d20cc0654ff44b0b7716f41837cf04acd2fbd022114e3f090702363.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) The middle figure is rotated 90º clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/165df9e9a74786030529952a5b4a2122f81fb49885d9adc84be3563336a01164.png] 

2) New letters formed and shifted in the clockwise direction in every next figure. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbfc78fcd1fa4da455158e78bc2e3103a583d1b6eb2c5f8d25a88d3239fb5c5e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
